title: Product turntable (3D)
description: A product on a lit pedestal: it lowers in with a quarter turn, the camera orbits slowly and 2-3 spec callouts draw leader lines to points on the object. Default product is an original speaker built from primitives; set model to show your own GLB.

title.description: Headline; wrap one word in {braces} for the italic serif accent.

subline.description: Line under the pedestal. Simple HTML allowed (<b> = accent).

model.description: Path to a local .glb/.gltf inside the scene (e.g. assets/models/product.glb). Empty = the built-in speaker. Record the model's licence in assets/CREDITS.md.

modelHeight.description: Height of the product in scene units (the pedestal is 2.64 wide). A GLB is scaled so its largest side has this size.

productColor.description: Shell colour of the built-in speaker.

callouts.description: 2-3 items {value, detail, point, side}. point = [x, y, z] inside the product's bounding box, -1..1 per axis (y 1 = top, z 1 = front face). side = left | right (label column).

calloutStart.description: Second the first callout appears; the others follow every 0.45 s.

orbitDegrees.description: How far the camera travels around the product over the scene. Keep it under ~70 so front callouts stay visible.

theme.description: Backdrop variant from base.css (the pedestal follows it).

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47). Sets <html lang>.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: callout dots sit on the product in every still
labels do not overlap the product
real product specs only (or mark the product as an example)
